findings.summary: The readers-and-writers section omits the PlantStructure to PlantBreakdownNode rename. Production code reaches the renamed class and its slots at group_enrichment.py:74, plant_context.py:21,179,187,270,279 and test_plant_context_graph.py:18,29, so a migration run from this record would not be told those sites must change.
The ArchiveFieldPattern row ends '</tr>>'. The stray '>' renders as a literal character; check_record.py's tag-balance parser cannot see it because it is text.

The legend gives grey dashed the meaning 'retired', but the 'source component reference' box at ontology-proposal.svg:2288 uses the same style. A reader following the legend reads an active source input as a retired element.

The tests line names check_record.py but no test_logs is recorded and record-check.log:1 is stale at revision 816fdec with 'checks run: 12'. The 17-check head pass survives only as a session-stream tool result at 2026-11-23T07:09:24Z.

The documentation denominator is the literal ROOTS list of eleven codes, so '11 of 11' is counted against a constant. The run's own control_node_one read matches today, but a later first-level node would leave it silently reporting 11 of 11.
